ck_asset_pos_range.name: ck_asset_pos_range
ck_asset_pos_range.value:
("asset"."posX" IS NULL OR "asset"."posX" BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
          AND ("asset"."posY" IS NULL OR "asset"."posY" BETWEEN 0 AND 1)

ck_asset_pos_needs_sub_location.name: ck_asset_pos_needs_sub_location
ck_asset_pos_needs_sub_location.value: "asset"."posX" IS NULL OR "asset"."subLocationId" IS NOT NULL

ck_asset_origin_chain.name: ck_asset_origin_chain
ck_asset_origin_chain.value:
("asset"."origin" = 'PO_FLOW'
             AND "asset"."requestId" IS NOT NULL
             AND "asset"."grpoLineId" IS NOT NULL
             AND "asset"."poItemId" IS NOT NULL
             AND "asset"."unitNo" IS NOT NULL
             AND "asset"."acquisitionCost" IS NOT NULL
             AND "asset"."createdBy" IS NOT NULL
             AND "asset"."updatedBy" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("asset"."origin" = 'SAP_LEGACY'
             AND "asset"."requestId" IS NULL
             AND "asset"."grpoLineId" IS NULL
             AND "asset"."poItemId" IS NULL
             AND "asset"."unitNo" IS NULL
             AND "asset"."assetNumber" IS NOT NULL)
